summary.text: Marsia Geldert-Murphey is the Democratic candidate for Illinois State Senate District 56 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent Republican Erica Harriss. In a Ballotpedia survey, she said she has worked as a civil engineer for more than 30 years.

paragraphs.text: Geldert-Murphey won the Democratic primary on March 17, 2026.
In her Ballotpedia survey, she listed infrastructure, education and health care as her three key campaign messages.
She said she has helped build infrastructure in most of the district's communities and wants to expand opportunity in industries such as clean energy, manufacturing and logistics.
She also said she supports expanding access to early care and education and fully funding school nutrition programs, and that Medicaid cuts are limiting access to care.
